# Resource: tfe_terraform_version

Manages Terraform versions available on HCP Terraform and Terraform Enterprise.

-> **Note:** You can fetch a Terraform version ID from the URL of an existing version in the HCP Terraform UI. The ID is in the format `tool-<RANDOM STRING>`.

## Example Usage

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.terraformVersion.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        new TerraformVersion(this, "test", new TerraformVersionConfig()
                .sha("e75ac73deb69a6b3aa667cb0b8b731aee79e2904")
                .url("https://tfe-host.com/path/to/terraform.zip")
                .version("1.1.2-custom")
                );
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version` (String) A semantic version string in N.N.N or N.N.N-bundleName format.

### Optional

- `archs` (Attributes Set) A list of architecture-specific binaries for this Terraform version. When specifying architecture-specific binaries, the top-level `url` and `sha` attributes are deprecated and should not be used. If both top-level `url` and `sha` are specified, an `archs` entry for the `amd64` architecture must also be included, and its `url` and `sha` values must match the top-level values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--archs))
- `beta` (Boolean) Whether or not this version of Terraform is beta pre-release. Defaults to `false`.
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether or not this version of Terraform is deprecated. Defaults to `false`.
- `deprecatedReason` (String) Additional context about why a version of Terraform is deprecated. Defaults to `null` unless `deprecated` is `true`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not this version of Terraform is enabled for use in HCP Terraform and Terraform Enterprise. Defaults to `true`.
- `official` (Boolean) Whether or not this is an official release of Terraform. Defaults to `false`.
- `sha` (String) (Soon to be deprecated) The SHA-256 checksum of the compressed Terraform binary.
- `url` (String) (Soon to be deprecated) The URL where a ZIP-compressed 64-bit Linux binary of this version can be downloaded.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Terraform version.

<a id="nestedatt--archs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `archs`

Required:

- `arch` (String) The architecture for which this binary is intended.
- `os` (String) The operating system for which this binary is intended.
- `sha` (String) The SHA-256 checksum of the compressed binary.
- `url` (String) The URL where a ZIP-compressed binary of this version can be downloaded.




## Import

Resource tfe_terraform_version can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <TERRAFORM VERSION ID>
terraform import tfe_terraform_version.test tool-L4oe7rNwn7J4E5Yr

# via <TERRAFORM VERSION NUMBER>
terraform import tfe_terraform_version.test 1.1.2
```
